metadata.description: The rohlik-replenish plugin: an agent skill that fills your Rohlik.cz cart from your order history.

plugins.name: rohlik-replenish
plugins.description: Fills your Rohlik.cz cart for the next delivery from your own order history, without asking what to buy. You review the cart and check out yourself: it never places an order. Rohlik.cz (Czech Republic) only.
